summary: The flows are unchanged, the current word is readable, the per-word timing code is unchanged, and the landscape layout is clear for the shipped titles. One item blocks: the new two-tone focus ring (C-F1 fix) does not reach most buttons. Its brown ring is a box-shadow, and the rule main[data-place] button (specificity 0,1,2) sets a box-shadow that beats button:focus-visible (0,1,1). Only the 3 px white outline is left on those buttons, and white on the cream panels is 1.04 to 1. Round 1 finding C-F1 is therefore open in a changed form (C2-F1). C-F2 and C-F3 are closed. Two nonblocking items follow: the band plaque rule defeats the fitted font (C2-F2), and a 60-character title can touch the label in landscape (C2-F3). No browser, build, or server ran, so C2-F1 rests on cascade reading.
blocking_findings: C2-F1 [Major] review-c: The two-tone focus ring does not reach the buttons inside main[data-place], so C-F1 is not closed. look.css:42-47 sets outline 3px solid #fff, offset 0, and box-shadow 0 0 0 6px #92400e on a:focus-visible and button:focus-visible. The selector button:focus-visible has specificity (0,1,1). The rule main[data-place] button (look.css:405-420) has specificity (0,1,2) and sets box-shadow, so it wins in every state, and the same holds for [data-part=decodable] section[data-page-number] > p button (look.css:555-569, box-shadow: none), [data-part=decodable] div > section[aria-label]:last-child button (look.css:590-600), the amber sound and song buttons (look.css:446-454), the mode buttons (look.css:433-439), and the tile links main[data-place] ul[data-week-tiles] a (look.css:320-331, box-shadow with inset amber). On these controls the brown ring is lost, and only the white outline is left. Computed contrast of that outline: 1.04 to 1 against cream #fffaf0, 1.44 to 1 against amber #fcd34d. The decodable word buttons (transparent, on the cream sentence card), the sound button, the tricky-word chips, and the speaker button sit on cream panels, so a keyboard user sees no ring there; in round 1 the gold ring measured 1.70 to 1 on cream, so these cases are worse, not better. The ring works on the pages without data-place (sign-in, join, 404, teacher), because the Tailwind utilities lose to the unlayered rule, and on the read-along words (C2 item 2 below). Rationale: the Red case look-brand-chrome.test.ts:1071-1113 reads only the declarations of the one focus rule and never the cascade, and no gate row reads a focused control, so the test passes while the browser shows a white ring on cream. Evidence: look.css:42-47, 320-331, 405-420, 433-454, 555-600; grep of look-phase2-browser-gate.sh finds no focus row; gate-r3.log has no focus line. Proposal: FIX by Green: raise the focus rule above the control rules (for example html body :is(a, button):focus-visible) and keep the box-shadow ring with !important, or draw the second tone with a second outline-like layer that no control rule sets (outline plus outline-offset 3 px in brown on a white inner ring cannot both be outlines, so use box-shadow with !important). Red adds a gate row: focus a decodable word button, a mode button, and a tile with the keyboard, and read the computed box-shadow for rgb(146, 64, 14) and the outline for white. Confidence: medium; the specificity values are exact, and the claim has no browser proof.
nonblocking_findings: C2-F2 [Minor] review-c: The band plaque rule defeats the fitted font that Green moved into CSS. look.css:211-216 sets font-size 44px for header[data-hero=band] > h1, with specificity (0,1,2), equal to the fitted rule header[data-hero] > h1 (look.css:179-209), and it comes later, so it wins. The inline clamp that round 1 relied on also fitted the band plaque (24 px floor, 44 px cap). Now a band screen (reader, decodable, question) always has 44 px. The shipped titles of 6 to 13 characters still fit (gate-r3.log brand banner and frame rows pass), so the user flow is unharmed. A 60-character title on a band screen wraps to about four lines of 55 px and grows upward from the bottom anchor, over the label and the logo. The comment at look.css:210 says the band keeps the 24 px floor, which the rule contradicts. The Red case F-2b (look-brand-chrome.test.ts:968-1004) reads the first matching rule only, and the gate long-title row opens /st/3/6, the cover variant, so neither sees the band. This is a Review A correctness item in part; I list it because it changes the layout of a covered screen. Proposal: FIX by Green (delete font-size from the band rule, or use the same clamp with the 44 px cap), with one Red case that reads every h1 rule. Cross-check with Review A r2.

C2-F3 [Nit] review-c: A 60-character title at 844 x 390 likely touches the label. In the landscape block the label sits at left 72 px, top 18 px, height 23 px (y 18 to 41). The plaque is anchored 16 px below the 64 px hero. gate-r3.log shows plaque_h_px=52 for the 60-character title at 844x390, so the plaque spans y 28 to 80 and, with two wrapped lines at 20 px, can start left of the label end (about x 232 in Thai). The overlap would be about 13 px in height. For the shipped titles the plaque starts at x 550 or more and hud_overlap_px=0 (gate-r3.log, council hud label). The gate long-title row measures overflow and clipping only, not the label. Proposal: ACCEPT as a stress case, or Red adds the label box to the long-title row. No browser measured this; the numbers come from the CSS and the gate log.

C2-F4 [Nit] review-c: The comment in packages/read-along/lib/highlight.ts says white on brown #92400e measures 8.6:1. The computed value is 7.09 to 1 (WCAG formula). The second pair, brown on amber #fcd34d, is 4.92 to 1, which matches the comment. Both pairs pass 4.5 to 1. Proposal: FIX the number in the comment (Green, optional).
evidence: HEAD equals audited_head_sha 4b9033cec86ccf2cdf9a48702d39271943f17018 (git rev-parse HEAD). Round 2 range 4eebabbb2..4b9033cec read for apps/storytime/app, apps/storytime/lib, packages/read-along/components, and packages/read-along/lib/highlight.ts.
Contract applicability: applicable (same as round 1). The range changes in apps/storytime/app only frame.tsx and look.css. No route, endpoint, action, or API response changed.

Focus item 1, flows: frame.tsx changes the logo size attributes (46 to 48) and removes the inline font size of the h1; it keeps lang=en, the title text, the logo alt, and the label. look.css changes colors, the ring, the plaque font rule, and the landscape label position. No href, form, aria attribute, onClick, disabled, or min-h class changed in any screen file. Tap sizes in look.css (52 px buttons, 48 px word buttons) are unchanged; gate-r3.log shows tap_under_48=0 for the 24 captures and the child rows.

Focus item 2, ring on read-along words: read-along-passage.tsx changes class strings only: focus-visible:ring-2, ring-[#92400e], ring-offset-2, ring-offset-[#fffaf0] for the sentence and for a word with tabIndex -1. No look.css rule sets box-shadow on [data-sentence] or [data-word], so the Tailwind ring shows. Computed contrast: brown ring 6.81 to 1 against the cream offset, 5.69 to 1 against the pale amber band #fde68a, 4.92 to 1 against amber #fcd34d. The offset gap is cream, so the ring has a clear inner edge on the band and on the brown current word. The ring works there. The ring does not work on the buttons (C2-F1).

Focus item 2, ring on the pages without data-place: the Tailwind utilities are layered and lose to the unlayered focus rule, so the white outline and the 6 px brown box-shadow both show on the sign-in, join, 404, st fallback, and teacher controls. Brown on cream is 6.81 to 1.

Focus item 3, current word: the class pair is bg-[#92400e] text-white (7.09 to 1) and, for dark mode, bg-[#fcd34d] text-[#92400e] (4.92 to 1). The word block is brown on a #fde68a band (5.69 to 1), so it separates from the band. r3-02-week1-highlight.png shows Hello in white on brown inside the pale amber band; the other words use the old navy ink because the capture predates Green r3. Ink checks: #3b1d0a on cream 14.78 to 1, on #fde68a 12.34 to 1; #6b3a14 on cream 9.01 to 1, on #fef3c7 8.42 to 1.

Focus item 3, timing code: git diff 3480f904c..4b9033cec -- packages/read-along/hooks apps/storytime/lib/highlight-windows.ts is empty (0 bytes). The only read-along files changed in the phase are the passage class strings, highlight.ts class strings, and tests.

Focus item 4, landscape 844 x 390: logo box x 16 to 64, y 8 to 56 (look.css:155-171). Label box starts at x 72 (look.css:764-768), y 18 to 41, white-space nowrap, no overflow rule, so the Thai label cannot clip; the gap to the logo is 8 px. The plaque is right-anchored (right 22 px) and, for 6 to 13 character titles at 32 px, starts at x 550 or more; the label ends at about x 232 in Thai. gate-r3.log: hud_overlap_px=0, clipped_text=0 for th and en at 844x390, and plaque_overflow_px=0 for the 60-character title. The test F-3b models the label width as one character, so it is weak, but the geometry holds for the real label.

Focus item 5, r3 evidence: r3-02 and r3-03 (th, 390 x 844) show the logo at the top left, the label centered, the amber plaque below the hero with no overlap, the brown tiles with amber edges, and the pressed Read it to me button in amber. gate-r3.log rows for brand chrome, brand tones, brand banner, and the 24 captures pass. The FAIL rows in gate-r3.log are the song active-line rows, the lyric row, and the teacher week row (console_errors=6, tap_under_48=5); they belong to Review A and to the teacher session fix, not to this role, and I did not re-raise them. The captures predate Green r3 (the ink), so the ink colors in them are old. The gate has no focus row, no landscape capture image, and no band long-title case.

Round 1 findings: C-F1 open in changed form (C2-F1; read-along words and the plain pages are fixed, the buttons and tiles in main[data-place] are not). C-F2 closed: look.css:463-469 sets #fde68a with a brown label, 5.69 to 1, and the Red case C-F2 reads it. C-F3 closed by decision (the 48 px floor covers the child screens only, as the orchestrator stated; I did not read the spec text of the decision).
Not run: vitest, tsc, ESLint, any browser, any server. Not re-raised: Review A items.
